caption: The drawing shows two views (front and back) of a sculptural figure shaped like a child's doll or statuette. The figure has curly hair and a rounded face and is presented in gold and brown tones with dark shading and highlights. The body of the figure is composed of an assemblage of various small objects, including gears, buttons, bolts, screws, metal parts, coils, springs, tools, utensils, cups, and seashells. These objects are intricately arranged to form the torso, arms, and base of the figure, creating a highly textured surface. The objects are mostly rendered in brown, gold, and brass hues with touches of red, blue, and black. The base of each figure is wide and flares out, resembling a bell or pedestal, with visible patches of yellow and areas of rust or corrosion. The background is plain, light beige, and unadorned, with a faint border marking the edges of the drawing.
title: Figure
